reason: The question asks for the founding year of the global airline alliance that United is a founding member of. The top raw candidates include a mention of Oneworld alliance (unit_id 5a84a9425542991dd0999d66::History of Kingfisher Airlines::11) but not United's membership. derived_candidates.text: United Airlines is a founding member of the Star Alliance, not Oneworld.
The Oneworld alliance was founded on 1 February 1999, not 14 May 1997.
